sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – English Common Law and French Civil Law, with recognition of customary law under the Constitution of 1980
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force since 2020
Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement (MSGTA), Vanuatu member party
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement currently in force; Vanuatu operates a tax-exempt territorial regime for International Companies

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 36 of 2021 (as amended); International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 241), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2011 and consolidated by the International Companies Act No. 32 of 2022; Companies Act Cap. 3 (domestic companies); VFSC AML/CFT Supervisory Rules and Guidance Notes 2022; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) reporting obligations under the AML/CFT Act 2021

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport for each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority in the country of residence or nationality of the individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or Consular Legalization if the origin country is not a Hague Apostille Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized police clearance certificate or certificate of good conduct for each director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national police or justice authority in the country of residence of the individual

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized banker's reference letter confirming source of funds and professional standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank or accredited financial institution in the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized general power of attorney appointing the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized executed memorandum and articles of association for the International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public before whom the subscriber directors execute the constitutional documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced screening of all directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, authorized signatories, and counterparties against the OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU and UK sanctions lists as transposed by Vanuatu practice, and domestic Vanuatu designations; mandatory PEP status determination under the AML/CFT Act No. 36 of 2021 and VFSC guidance, including source-of-wealth verification, ongoing transaction monitoring, and immediate escalation and suspicious transaction report filing with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit where risk indicators appear

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Company Registry and e-Registration Portal (www.vfsc.vu electronic registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names must be submitted in Latin script; names may use English or French wording; a statutory suffix must appear exactly as required, namely 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Public Limited Company', or their abbreviations; foreign-script transliterations require official romanization; the proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing, reserved, or registered name in Vanuatu; names implying government patronage, licensable activities, or regulated financial status are prohibited
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a written request for reconsideration with the VFSC Corporate Registry within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, stating legal grounds and submitting up to three alternative names without prohibited tokens; the VFSC Registrar must issue a decision within 14 business days; a further administrative appeal lies to the Minister responsible for financial services; the fastest reinstatement route is resubmission of a compliant name through the e-registry with the applicable resubmission fee; rejected applicants may also request a 30-day extension of any valid name reservation before expiry

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted and standard for International Companies: Vanuatu law does not require operating premises or business substance in Vanuatu; the licensed registered agent's official address serves as the statutory registered office; fully virtual operations for a non-licensed, non-regulated ISIC 4791 B2B wholesale platform are accepted, provided the company maintains a current registered office and licensed registered agent in Vanuatu
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated annual probability below 5% for a standard unlicensed International Company absent triggering events; unannounced inspections are legally authorized under the AML/CFT Act No. 36 of 2021 and VFSC supervisory powers, and inspection risk would materially increase if the company later obtains a VFSC financial services license, becomes subject to a suspicious activity report, or generates irregular payment-rail activity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and reservation application fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per International Company formation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille or consular legalization of passport, police clearance, bank reference, and supporting identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent authentication authority in the document origin country
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per document set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarized power of attorney preparation and authentication
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC International Company incorporation government fee, first year, authorized capital not exceeding USD 10,000
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office provision, first annual year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark including statutory filings

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register establishment and initial filing with the VFSC corporate registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for preparation and submission of the beneficial ownership record

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation, notarial liaising, and international courier handling of the apostilled document bundle

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], ss. 4-8 (incorporation), s. 9 (name restrictions), s. 15 (registered office), s. 31 (register of members); Electronic Transactions Act [Cap. 246] for digital filings; Companies (Amendment) Act 2021.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry, Rue Pasteur, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (VFSC Form IC-01) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow or capital deposit required at incorporation. Share capital may be denominated in any eligible currency and shares issued for cash or non-cash consideration; liability of members is limited.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: 1. The incorporation of the Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] as filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission is hereby ratified and confirmed. 2. The initial subscription of one ordinary share fully paid at USD 1.00 per share is approved and the register of members be opened. 3. The registered office be established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu. 4. [Name] is appointed first Director and [Name] first Corporate Secretary, each consenting to act. 5. Any one Director is authorised to open bank accounts with any licensed bank, adopt payment rails including SWIFT and Alibaba Pay, and execute all banking mandates and statutory returns.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry (online e-services portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name search of the proposed company name against the VFSC register of international companies. File a name reservation request confirming the name is not identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name. Avoid restricted words (e.g., Bank, Trust, Insurance, Government) unless prior approval is obtained. For an electronic B2B marketplace, use a neutral trade-name suffix such as 'B2B Marketplace Ltd'.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries or rejects the name, select an alternative name from the submitted options and re-file within 14 calendar days; amend M&A name clause accordingly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to draft the standard-form IC Memorandum and Articles of Association conforming to the IC Act Schedule. Include general commercial powers covering electronic wholesale platform operation, cross-border goods brokerage, payment facilitation via third-party rails, and ancillary activities. Confirm registered office address in Port Vila and appoint the registered agent as required by section 15 of the IC Act.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport of each shareholder and director
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
Bank reference letter (if requested by agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC comments on the M&A, the registered agent amends the draft and resubmits; any objection is cured by filing a notice of ratification with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit VFSC Form IC-01 together with the signed M&A, statement of compliance under section 5 of the IC Act, consent of the registered agent, and KYC dossier. File electronically via the VFSC approved filing portal, pay the USD 350 government filing fee by bank transfer or card, and retain the payment receipt with the application reference number.
required_dossiers: Certified KYC documents of shareholders and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a deficiency requisition, cure within 14 days by amending and resubmitting the identified documents; if the requisition is unfounded, file a written appeal to the Registrar under section 40 of the IC Act for a determination.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated as of the day of incorporation. Verify the company name, registered number, date, and liability status on the certificate. Obtain the certified copy of the M&A, extract of the register of directors and shareholders, and the registered agent certificate evidencing the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the approved application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an error in name, number, or date, apply to VFSC for a corrected re-issuance under statutory rectification procedure within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution and appointment of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company board of directors / licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene a written meeting of the board by circulation or physical meeting at the registered office. Pass the first board resolution covering ratification of incorporation, allotment of one fully paid ordinary share, adoption of the registered office at the agent's address, and appointment of the first Director and Corporate Secretary. Execute the consent-to-act forms for each officer and file a copy in the statutory records maintained by the agent.
required_dossiers: Consent-to-act forms for directors and secretary
Share subscription letter from the sole subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Internal governance document; any omission is curable by a subsequent written resolution signed by all directors confirming ratification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation bank account opening and payment rails enablement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial banks in Vanuatu (e.g., ANZ, Bred Bank, National Bank of Vanuatu) and third-party payment service providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account with a VFSC-licensed bank to enable SWIFT wire transfers. Submit the certificate of incorporation, M&A, registered agent certificate, board resolution for account opening, and KYC pack. Concurrently onboard the Alibaba Pay merchant channel under a PSP agreement using the corporate bank account as settlement account; complete AML/CFT screening (beneficial ownership register with the agent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises AML queries, provide enhanced due diligence on source of funds and beneficial owners; if declined, apply to an alternative licensed bank or request intercession by the registered agent with the VFSC-approved banking panel.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable. Non-manufacturing, paperless B2B electronic marketplace; no industrial plant or physical goods handling facility in Vanuatu. Supervisory touchpoint is the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission for AML/CFT compliance via the registered agent.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating or manufacturing license required for ISIC 4791 e-commerce platform operations. Compliance reference instruments: Electronic Transactions Act [Cap. 246]; Data Protection Act 2022 (personal data handling); cross-border goods brokerage activity is not a licensed activity in Vanuatu.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Energy, Environment, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - registration-trigger check only. Physical presence is limited to a registered office, which falls below screening thresholds under the Environment (EIA) Regulations 2012; no EIA report or registration certificate required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste generation. Applicable standards limited to municipal approved wastewater/septic disposal under the Water Supply Act [Cap. 147] and e-waste recycling via DEPC-approved vendors under the Waste Management Act Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Occupational clearance for the registered office only: fire safety inspection certificate under the Building Act [Cap. 181] and the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services Act 2017; maintain fire extinguishers, egress lighting, and occupancy load within local limits. If no employees are physically present in Vanuatu, a self-declared home-office exemption applies; no industrial structural load inspection is required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA) under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; online filing and compliance portal: VRCA Online Services (https://online.vrca.vu); customs declarations processed through ASYCUDA World; corporate registry functions administered separately by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) is not automatically issued a national tax identification number unless it has taxable operations in Vanuatu or voluntarily registers for VAT. Procedure: (1) complete VAT registration application Form VAT-01 via the VRCA Online Services portal; (2) submit certified certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing issued by VFSC, proof of registered agent in Vanuatu, and identity documentation for directors/shareholders; (3) declare a local address for service of documents; (4) where the IC conducts exclusively offshore business, submit a statutory declaration confirming no local taxable supplies are made in Vanuatu and obtain a written exclusion or exemption confirmation from VRCA; (5) upon approval, VRCA issues a Value Added Tax Registration Number (VRN) in the format VU-XXXXX and files the entity in the national tax register.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu levies no income tax, no capital gains tax, and no withholding tax; therefore no check-the-box, entity classification, or hybrid mismatch elections exist under Vanuatu law. The IC regime itself functions as a statutory elective exemption under the International Companies Act: an IC may elect to remain a non-local, tax-exempt offshore vehicle solely by observing the prohibition on conducting domestic business in Vanuatu, trading with Vanuatu residents, owning Vanuatu land, and carrying on prescribed licensed local activities. If the IC breaches those limits, it loses the exemption and becomes subject to the ordinary VAT regime with an option to apply for voluntary VAT registration; there is no further statutory entity-level election available under the VAT Act.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) governed by the Value Added Tax Act No. 2 of 1998 (Cap. 245), as amended by the VAT (Amendment) Acts of 2012 and 2023; administered by VRCA.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 in aggregate taxable supplies over any rolling 12-month period (approximately USD 42,000 at prevailing exchange rates). Suppliers whose taxable supplies are exclusively zero-rated export or offshore services may still voluntarily register to claim input VAT credits; a non-resident or IC making no Vanuatu-source taxable supplies does not trigger the compulsory threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu has not implemented mandatory electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, or digital stamping. Tax invoices may be issued in paper or electronic format under the VAT Act. A valid tax invoice must show the supplier's name, address, VRN, invoice date, description and quantity of goods or services, amount exclusive of VAT, VAT amount separately, and the headline rate applied; for zero-rated exports, the invoice must explicitly state the zero rate and cross-reference the supporting customs documentation. No government API or continuous fiscal data transmission is required for invoice issuance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods physically exported from Vanuatu, provided the exporter retains proof that the goods left Vanuatu within 30 days of supply, and to services supplied to a person who remains outside Vanuatu at the time the services are performed, where the benefit of the supply is not derived by a Vanuatu resident or used in Vanuatu. An International Company may claim zero rating only to the extent the supply originates from Vanuatu or passes through Vanuatu customs; purely offshore platform intermediary services supplied by an IC to overseas buyers are outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT altogether and require no VAT charge, while goods exported through the marketplace qualify for the 0% rate. Claims must be supported by contemporaneous commercial contracts, purchase orders, logistics records, customs declarations, and verifiable payment evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged through ASYCUDA World bearing the VRCA customs seal and export declaration number
Bill of Lading, airway bill, or equivalent transport document evidencing physical movement of goods out of Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a licensed bank confirming receipt of hard currency proceeds from the overseas buyer
Commercial invoice, packing list, and certificate of origin (where required by the destination jurisdiction)
Signed B2B marketplace sales agreement or platform service order demonstrating the offshore counterparty and free-on-board / ex-works delivery terms
Warehouse or inventory transfer records proving the goods were never consumed, sold, or delivered within Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA and the State Law Office may conduct post-clearance audits for a period of at least five years from the date of export claim. Where zero-rating is claimed without compliant export documentation, the VAT becomes immediately payable with interest from the date of supply. Fraudulent zero-rating claims attract an additional penalty not exceeding 200% of the tax understated, forfeiture of the goods or their value, and criminal prosecution carrying fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to two years; deliberate falsification of customs declarations may result in suspension of the exporter's registration and revocation of the IC's exemption certificate by VFSC. Recovered amounts are clawed back with compounded statutory interest, and ring-fencing of refunds is available only to registered persons with a clean compliance record. Since the IC earns no Vanuatu-source income and requires no income tax filing, all substantive audit exposure in this structure centers on VAT zero-rating substantiation, customs valuation, and proof of non-resident supply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the National Foreign Exchange Control Authority under delegated powers conferred by the Exchange Control Act [Cap 55]; ultimate policy oversight rests with the Vanuatu Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, while the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) remains the licensing authority for International Companies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is a current-account convertible currency under Vanuatu's Article VIII obligations to the International Monetary Fund; trade payments and service-related remittances flow freely through RBV-authorized dealers. Capital-account transfers remain nominally subject to exchange-control approval, but Vanuatu applies a liberal review standard, and an International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is treated as non-resident, making proceeds and distributions presumptively eligible for unrestricted outward remittance once exchange-control declarations and bank-level due diligence are satisfied. Profit remittance hurdles are minimal: the IC pays no domestic corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no withholding tax on dividends, interest, or management fees; the only practical friction points are confirmation of source of funds by the remitting bank and completion of the prescribed exchange-control forms.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender requirement and no mandatory vatu conversion quota in Vanuatu. Export receipts arising from offshore B2B marketplace operations may be retained in VUV or in permitted foreign-currency accounts (principally USD, AUD, EUR, NZD, and GBP) held with an RBV-authorized dealer; no regulatory timeline compels conversion of export proceeds into vatu. The applicable Exchange Control General Rules require only prompt inward-remittance declaration and retention of supporting trade documentation for audit purposes, not the sale or conversion of foreign currency to a government-designated account.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Non-Resident Operational Account (VUV and USD multi-currency)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Vanuatu has no dedicated e-money institution (EMI) licensing category; the National Payment System Act grants payment-service licensing powers to the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu, but resident licensed payment providers are scarce, and offshore digital EMIs frequently decline to service tax-exempt International Companies because of regional correspondent-bank de-risking. The viable Tier-2 structure is a regulated global B2B payment facilitator acting as an unlicensed software and payout-agent layer over a fully licensed Vanuatu authorized-dealer bank account, never as the primary custodian of client funds; this preserves regulatory defensibility while enabling Alibaba_Pay and SWIFT wire connectivity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Port Vila-based commercial banks generally require an in-person due-diligence interview with at least one executive director or board-authorized signatory at the bank's branch, or an equivalent face-to-face meeting conducted through the bank's recognized foreign correspondents or service hubs. Purely remote account opening is not standardized; a hybrid protocol is commonly accepted where certified true passport copies, a professional banker's reference from the applicant's home-jurisdiction financial institution, and a notarized board resolution accompany a secure video-conference appearance approved by the authorized dealer's compliance committee. Fully non-appearance onboarding is available only to repeat institutional introducers or where an existing RBV-authorized bank provides a parent guarantee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived beneficial-ownership opacity associated with an International Company structure bearing nominee directors or bearer-style documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certificate of incorporation for the International Company; current registered-agent certificate and registered-office certificate; completed ultimate beneficial ownership declaration with a register of beneficial owners; constitutional documents confirming wholly legal ownership; apostilled and notarized passport pages of all natural-person shareholders and directors; and a written legal opinion from licensed Vanuatu counsel confirming the absence of bearer-share issuance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt status misinterpreted by correspondent compliance teams as a sign of round-tripping, sanctions evasion, or illicit tax arbitrage
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: International Companies Act [Cap 222] certificate confirming zero domestic tax capacity; a technical tax-exemption memorandum from Vanuatu counsel; the executed B2B marketplace master agreement and a commercial substance narrative demonstrating that the Vanuatu vehicle only holds settlement rights and routes the non-resident cross-border transaction flow; and an economic-substance statement confirming that all underlying goods and services are supplied outside Vanuatu.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner domiciled in a jurisdiction appearing on FATF monitored lists or subject to international sanctions screening flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-year source-of-wealth file comprising certified bank statements, shareholder loan agreements, and asset disposition contracts; an independent adverse-media screening report; professional references from licensed legal or accounting firms; citizenship and residency certificates; and a nil-sanctions match report generated against United Nations, OFAC, EU, and United Kingdom consolidated sanctions lists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border marketplace settlement pattern risk involving multiple counterparties, small-ticket transactions, and immediate layering movement of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed platform terms, merchant agreements, and marketplace operational playbook; a full transaction reconciliation ledger linking each settlement to a verified invoice; active-merchant KYC packs per counterparty comprising licenses, passports, and proof of address; real-time transaction reporting commitment to the banking compliance team; and an auditable payout and settlement schedule demonstrating that funds move only against completed commercial transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection sourced from a third-country account inconsistent with the declared B2B marketplace business scope
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed capital contribution or shareholder loan instrument; source-of-funds banking evidence from the remitting account holder; the exchange-control inward remittance declaration; a board resolution ratifying the injection and clearly articulating its use for marketplace liquidity rebate deposits; and a funds-flow diagram showing the complete chain from originator through correspondent banks to the Vanuatu receiving account.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing uses SWIFT MT103 with the purpose description 'Shareholder Equity Injection / Paid-Up Capital under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]' and the Standard Settlement Instruction of the receiving Vanuatu authorized-dealer bank; the remitting institution must attach a sponsor-bank letter confirming the KYC status of the capital provider. The receiving Vanuatu bank completes the Inward Remittance Declaration (Form IR) for exchange-control and statistical purposes, retains the board resolution and share-allotment minutes, and places the funds in an escrowed capital account segregated from operating vatu balances. Because the International Companies Act imposes no minimum paid-up capital, the injection amount is unrestricted; the decisive compliance gates are source-of-funds verification, beneficial ownership disclosure, and demonstration that the funds are not derived from proceeds of crime or sanctions-connected parties.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements flow through three principal rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers for operating disbursements, supplier payments, and marketplace payouts denominated in USD or other hard currencies; (ii) intra-bank book-transfer clearing for local and regional merchant payouts; and (iii) Commercial Letters of Credit forwarded by SWIFT MT700/MT707 for large-ticket B2B trade settlements, with MT202 COVER used for interbank cover through New York CHIPS or Fedwire correspondents. Vanuatu does not operate an offshore real-time gross settlement rail; clearance ultimately depends on the correspondent network of the RBV-licensed commercial banks. Each outward disbursement made by the International Company is exempt from Vanuatu withholding tax but must be supported by an approved invoice schedule and standing instructions, and capital-account outflows require exchange-control approval where the Exchange Control General Rules Manual so provides.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable VUV/USD and VUV/AUD forward contracts executed with an RBV-authorized dealer bank under a documented commercial trade-hedging rationale
Outright spot VUV exchange transactions for invoice settlement where natural offsetting of receivables and payables exists
Foreign-currency deposit swaps (parallel loans) between the Vanuatu entity and related group treasury entities, subject to bank compliance approval and transfer-pricing documentation
Currency swap arrangements with an authorized dealer for matched USD-denominated marketplace receivables against VUV operating-cost liabilities

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are generally unavailable for the vatu because no deliverable offshore VUV market exists; any NDF executed by a non-resident treasury desk must be kept off the Vanuatu entity's balance sheet and disclosed solely as an economic hedge of settlement exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return for an International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary day of incorporation in each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VT 5,000; continued default beyond one month after formal notice may lead to administrative dissolution and strike-off from the International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Retention / Government License Fee Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable together with the annual return no later than 30 days after the anniversary day of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment attracts a late penalty of up to VT 10,000 and may result in suspension or strike-off of the company after 90 days of continued default.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A standard Vanuatu International Company is exempt from mandatory audit unless it holds a VFSC licence (insurance, banking, securities or trust business), or shareholders holding not less than 10% of the issued shares demand an audit. No audit is otherwise required by law.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is imposed on a non-licensed International Company; where financial statements are prepared, International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or a comparable Board-approved framework is acceptable.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu does not maintain a public beneficial ownership register. A private beneficial ownership record must be kept by the registered agent and updated annually and on every share transfer; the annual return confirms that the company has complied with the International Companies Act and that the register of members reflects all current shareholdings.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 3,500 per engagement if voluntarily adopted

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, payroll tax, inheritance tax or gift tax on any company. An International Company (IC) registered under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (IC Act) benefits from a statutory zero-rate exemption under section 15 of that Act, covering income, profits, dividends, interest, royalties, capital gains and all transactions, with a guaranteed duration of at least 20 years from incorporation. Cross-border B2B digital services are zero-rated for VAT purposes. Loss carry-forward is legally irrelevant because no income tax base exists; the value of 0 reflects the absence of any taxable income regime.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC International Company Annual Renewal Form (IC-AR-01) — filed through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry online portal by a licensed registered agent
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than the annual anniversary of incorporation; a 30-day administrative grace period applies, after which late payment surcharges accrue by calendar month.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered legal name, IC registration number, date of incorporation, registered office and registered agent details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert VFSC certificate number; non-resident directors may sign under power of attorney; foreign street addresses are accepted for director service details.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, share classes, number of shares issued, and nationality breakdown of shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare capital in the original issue currency; no minimum capital certification is required; attach the beneficial ownership register maintained by the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business inside Vanuatu and owns no Vanuatu land; confirms continued eligibility for the IC Act 20-year tax exemption
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC operating a B2B marketplace wholly from abroad must select 'Offshore Supply'; disclose any domestic Vanuatu-resident counterparties to avoid automatic forfeiture of the exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of the annual VFSC fee by authorised capital band, agent certification, and proof of payment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees are payable in VUV or USD at the VFSC exchange rate; attach the SWIFT wire confirmation made from the IC's corporate bank account.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal attracts a 10% surcharge per commenced month on the annual fee; a continuous default exceeding three months may result in administrative strike-off; reinstatement requires payment of arrears, a reinstatement fee and VFSC penalties of up to VT 1,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (ESR Form) — submitted through the VFSC ESR e-Service portal by the registered agent or corporate service provider
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within six months after the end of each financial year; no statutory extension is available without written VFSC approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the relevant activity category; for this entity select 'Distribution and Service Centre' (electronic B2B wholesale platform operation, ISIC 4791)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs must elect the activity category even when all customers are foreign; disclose ancillary activities in the same box to prevent an erroneous 'no relevant activity' determination.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial year start and end dates covered by the return
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The period must match the reviewed or management accounts used for the annual renewal; winding-up companies file a short-period return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A3 — Gross Income from Relevant Activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross receipts including commissions, transaction fees, listing fees and advertising income, before expenses, stated in VUV or original currency
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report global gross platform receipts attributed to the IC; reconcile figures against payment-rail statements from Alibaba Pay and SWIFT wire cycles.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the operational office, lease or ownership basis, and nature of local facilities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A virtual registered-agent mailbox is insufficient; a leased serviced office with verifiable IT infrastructure and local staff work desks satisfies the ESR test.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Headcount, full-time/part-time status, qualifications and salary expense of staff engaged in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC must employ adequate full-time personnel in Vanuatu for procurement, order management, payment monitoring and risk functions; remote foreign contractors do not count unless formally seconded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Local payroll, rent, IT hosting, logistics and shared-service costs incurred in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A zero-expenditure or de minimis return indicates a shell; expenditures must support a genuine arm's-length distribution margin for the platform model.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of strategic and operational functions performed in Vanuatu: supplier onboarding, pricing, transaction processing, logistics coordination, dispute resolution and risk control
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Board meetings and commercial decisions on pricing and contracting must occur in Vanuatu, including by video-conference with documentation; retain minutes and travel records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the directors and countersignature of the registered agent; electronic signature and date
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may sign electronically; false statements trigger criminal liability for both the signatory and the agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or defective filing attracts an administrative penalty of up to VT 10,000,000 per return, plus a continuing daily penalty fixed by the competent authority; persistent default exposes the IC to deregistration, disclosure of information to foreign tax authorities, and criminal fine and/or imprisonment of responsible officers.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (Form VAT-100) — electronic portal of the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR); conditional filing only
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the month following the end of the tax period; not applicable where the IC holds the offshore exemption and makes no taxable supplies within Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 12.5% VAT on local taxable supplies; zero-rated for exported B2B platform services supplied to non-resident buyers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A wholly offshore IC enters zero; any Vanuatu-resident buyer transaction destroys the IC offshore exemption and requires immediate VAT registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Creditable VAT paid on local purchases of goods and services used for taxable supplies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only invoice-backed local expenditures are creditable; offshore procurement invoices are ineligible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Excess of output tax over input tax; amount payable to DCIR
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A refund position may arise for zero-rated exporters; attach the supporting schedule of foreign counterparties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment incurs a 20% flat penalty plus monthly interest on the unpaid VAT; deliberate suppression of domestic supply triggers criminal prosecution and fines of up to VT 10,000,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by an International Company; dividends paid to non-resident shareholders are wholly exempt under the IC Act exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no double taxation agreement network; no treaty relief or tax-residency certificate (TRC) mechanism exists. Protocol for cross-border payors requiring proof of exemption: (i) obtain a Certificate of Tax Exemption from the VFSC/DCIR confirming zero CIT and zero withholding; (ii) obtain a Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC; (iii) attach certified copies of the IC certificate and the 20-year exemption declaration; (iv) provide a beneficial ownership confirmation to the remitting bank. Foreign payors may apply domestic credit rules but cannot invoke a Vanuatu DTA because none is in force.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% statutory, nil treaty rate. Interest on debentures and intercompany loans: 0% statutory, nil treaty rate. Vanuatu law contains no domestic withholding tax on outbound or inbound payments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation and no Local File, Master File or CbCR regime; statutory threshold is VT 0. As VFSC administrative practice under the ESR regime, an IC must retain an economic-substance file containing arm's-length distribution-margin benchmarking whenever annual gross platform income exceeds VT 30,000,000 (approximately USD 250,000).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations Act No. 25 of 2019 and the ESR Regulations apply to every Vanuatu IC carrying on a 'relevant activity', which includes a 'Distribution and Service Centre' such as an electronic B2B wholesale platform. The IC must demonstrate in each financial year: (i) adequate physical premises in Vanuatu; (ii) adequate full-time employees in Vanuatu; (iii) adequate operating expenditure in Vanuatu; and (iv) performance of core income-generating activities and strategic management in Vanuatu. Compliance is evidenced through the annual ESR Return; failure triggers penalties, deregistration and automatic exchange of information with foreign competent authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false or misleading statements to VFSC or DCIR, including understating gross platform receipts in the ESR Return, back-dating board minutes, or declaring offshore-exempt status while secretly earning Vanuatu-source income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recovery of all evaded licence fees and VAT, administrative fines of up to VT 10,000,000, confiscation of the proceeds of the marketplace operation, deregistration, and reporting to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent are jointly and severally liable for restitution of unpaid duties; courts may impose exit/travel bans, order disqualification from managing Vanuatu companies, and impose imprisonment of up to two years for statutory offences and up to seven years for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and ESR Substance Default
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a mailbox-only registered office, zero employees, no local expenditure and no operational presence in Vanuatu while actively operating the B2B platform; failing to file the ESR Return or filing a 'no relevant activity' declaration despite active cross-border trading.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty up to VT 10,000,000 per return; daily default penalties; administrative strike-off; exchange of information with foreign tax authorities; inclusion of the entity in published non-compliant lists resulting in banking de-risking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the corporate service provider are personally accountable for penalties and costs; criminal prosecution of officers for continuing default; travel bans; disqualification from acting as director; potential imprisonment of up to two years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Breach of IC Exemption — Domestic Trading
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling goods or services to Vanuatu-resident buyers through the B2B marketplace, owning or leasing land in Vanuatu, or operating without a business licence while relying on the 20-year IC tax exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic and retroactive loss of the IC tax exemption from the date of breach; assessment of business licence fees on the turnover band and 12.5% VAT on local supplies; penalties of up to 200% of the underpaid tax; potential strike-off by VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for unpaid licence fees and VAT collected but not remitted; continued unlicensed trading is a criminal offence carrying fines and imprisonment; travel bans may be imposed pending settlement of the assessment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the marketplace as a conduit for money laundering through over-invoiced wholesale orders settled via Alipay or SWIFT wires, round-tripping funds to nominee shareholders, or facilitating sanctions evasion by onboarding prohibited counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offences under the Proceeds of Crime Act; fines up to VT 25,000,000, asset freezing and forfeiture, wire-level enforcement actions, and imprisonment of up to 15 years for principals; revocation of the IC registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are individually liable; courts issue travel bans and freezing orders against personal assets; disqualification from holding any financial services licence; extradition cooperation is available for cross-border fraud.
